summary: Did not remove legacy_total: contrary to the task, it is still used by reports/export.py to produce the gross (tax-included) amounts consumed by the accounting system. Removing it would break the export, and substituting total() would silently send net amounts. Findings and baseline are recorded in WORKLOG.md; no source code was changed.
assumptions: The export.py docstring is authoritative: the accounting system requires gross, tax-included amounts, so export output must not change.
Changing financial output to an external consumer is high-impact and outside a 'remove dead code' task, so it requires requester sign-off.
questions_for_requester: legacy_total is still called by reports/export.py (export_row). Should the gross-with-tax computation move into export.py or a new non-deprecated function (e.g. gross_total) so legacy_total can be removed with export output unchanged, or should the export switch to net totals (which changes what accounting receives)?
Is the accounting CSV export itself being retired, which would make legacy_total truly dead?
